rawContent: @MalikSana28 Hi all, my name is Nidhi and I am in the final year of my PhD in English at UWO. My research critiques the #metoo movement and it’s limitations in India by focusing on the representations of raped and abducted women during the 1947 Partition in Hindi cinema.

Working on the book chapter for the #metoo movement edited book today and realizing that the 4,000 word limit including references will take the next few days. It breaks my heart cutting it down but must be done!
As I work little bit today and tomorrow to finalize the #metoo book chapter for submission, I remembered my first publication. :-) https://t.co/r2m90oAnsw

Submitted my #metoo chapter with 3,990 words. The combination of having an academic community and Helen sword’s The Writer’s Diet made me think of writing in a new way of academic writing. https://t.co/gPsCMX9eKt
